fixed_at: 2026-10-06, b1-binfra, before any perturbation result (pre-registration: notebook entry 2026-10-06_*_b1-binfra_perturb-suite.md)
eval_set: perturb_3_15 (= first 1024 of main_3_15 in b1_eval_sets_v1.json; main set = front straight clearance >= 0.40 m)
eval_rules: eval_unbiased.py --phi canonical --seed 4242, first episode per env, deterministic tanh(mu), DR off nominal values then the condition params override, unfinished must be 0

contract_11_coverage.1_map_diversity: NOT COVERED - single warehouse map; training has no map DR and this suite has no map perturbation (the Isaac scene mesh and path pool are built from one map)
contract_11_coverage.2_accel_dynamics: covered: plant delay 0.12/0.16 s, plant time constant 0.16 s, plant accel limit scale 0.6, drive gain 0.8/1.2 (not in contract table); payload not modeled
contract_11_coverage.3_obstacle_behavior: NOT COVERED - static map only (dynamic obstacles out of bonus 1 scope, plan section 2)
contract_11_coverage.4_latency: covered partly: policy observation scan latency 0.1/0.2 s (scan_age reported like the plugin), action latency via plant pure delay; contract eval sweep goes to 0.3 s
contract_11_coverage.5_perception_noise: covered: LiDAR range sigma 0.09/0.12 m, beam dropout 0.05/0.10; track dropout / position / velocity noise not applicable (no tracks)

recommended_primary_endpoint: per seed: mean strict success over the 12 single-axis 'unseen' conditions (equal weight); DR on vs off difference of arm means with stratified bootstrap 95% interval over seeds; per-condition table and the combo / dr_edge rows reported separately (b1-dr fixes the final rule in its own pre-registration)
